newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu launched an appeal for national reconciliation during ceremonies marking World War I battles, calling on political forces to cooperate for building "the Romania of next millennium".

* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea's press conference scheduled for 2 p.m. has been postponed until the government drafts a new letter of intent binding Romania to achieve economic targets established by the loan memorandum with the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
* IMF's chief negotiator for Romania, Poul Thomsen, is expected to make statements for the press after his meeting with the cabinet.

* Ethnic Romanian nationalist Ilie Ilascu -- under death sentence for five years in Moldova's breakaway Dnestr region after being convicted of terrorism -- thanked Constantinescu for his birthday greetings.
The message, conveyed by Ilascu's wife, Nina, also contained an appeal to international organisations to intervene for easing Ilascu's imprisonment conditions.
* The military airport in Craiova will resume operations this week after being closed following an bomb blast in July which killed 16.

* Danube flow at the Portile de Fier (Iron Gates) hydro power plant has reached 8,050 cubic metres per second but is expected to recede over the coming days to reach 7,800 cubic metres at the weekend. The plant has an intake capacity of 9,000 cubic metres per second.
* Landslides in the western county of Arad have destroyed two km of local roads and 20 houses in a village.
* No cases of diarrhoea have been detected in the Prahova county in south Romania, one of the worst hit by floods in the past four days, the health ministry said.
* Weather conditions are unstable across the country, but rain is falling only in the mountains in northern Romania.
